Class AzureBlobStorageOperations

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.objectstorage.azure.AzureBlobStorageOperations
All Implemented Interfaces:
ObjectStorageOperations<com.azure.storage.blob.options.BlobParallelUploadOptions, com.azure.storage.blob.models.BlockBlobItem, com.azure.core.http.rest.Response<Void>>
@EachBean(com.azure.storage.blob.BlobContainerClient.class) @Requires(beans=com.azure.storage.blob.BlobContainerClient.class) @Requires(condition=AzureBlobStorageEnabledCondition.class) public class AzureBlobStorageOperations extends Object implements ObjectStorageOperations<com.azure.storage.blob.options.BlobParallelUploadOptions, com.azure.storage.blob.models.BlockBlobItem, com.azure.core.http.rest.Response<Void>>

    • listNativeBlobs

      protected @NonNull Iterable<com.azure.core.http.rest.PagedResponse<com.azure.storage.blob.models.BlobItem>> listNativeBlobs(String prefix, String continuationToken, int pageSize)
      Returns Azure-native paged blob responses for the requested prefix, continuation token, and page size. Subclasses may override this method only to customize page retrieval while preserving the Azure token and service-order semantics expected by listObjects(io.micronaut.objectstorage.request.ListObjectsRequest).
      Parameters:
      prefix - The raw key prefix filter, or null when no prefix filtering is requested
      continuationToken - The opaque Azure continuation token, or null for the first page
      pageSize - The requested maximum page size
      Returns:
      The Azure-native paged responses backing the current listing request
      Since:
      3.0.0
